summary: Message sends from peer-bound harnesses must name their own agent as sender; attempts to impersonate another agent, a person, or the daemon are refused before message acceptance.

replay.detail: Existing messages and replay remain unchanged.

compatibility.detail: POST /v1/messages and message.sent claims through POST /v1/claims return foreign-agent-actor when a peer-bound caller names a different normalized sender. Bound message.sent claims also require a non-null sender, checked before writes or idempotency replay. Its own agent label and stable identity are accepted. Unbound trusted-local callers retain sender selection; authenticated client send paths keep their existing authorization.

downtime.detail: No migration or fleet coordination required; normal daemon deployment activates the check.

manual.detail: Normal harness sends already use their own identity. A bound harness can no longer use the local CLI's explicit non-agent sender override.

recovery.detail: Revert the commit; stored messages require no conversion.
